choice:43:0:1.text: It's okay, I'm getting used to it...
choice:43:0:1.source_cn: 没关系，我也逐渐习惯了……

choice:21:0:1.text: Why not offer something more concrete?
choice:21:0:1.source_cn: 不如拿出点更实际的表示？

choice:21:1:2.text: When you're away from home, you rely on friends; no need to thank me.
choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 出门在外靠朋友，不用谢

choice:21:2:3.text: Just thank you, Antaya. I didn't do anything.
choice:21:2:3.source_cn: 感谢安特亚就好，我没做什么

choice:14:0:1.text: Really? I have a feeling he's still angry.
choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 真的吗？我怎么感觉他还在生气
